ellc_analysis.scope: Circular detached V505-scale real SAP data, local eclipse windows, no spots, no third light, no irradiation, fixed period, no light travel time or Doppler boosting. Baseline uses spherical stars and quadratic LD with shared u1 free/u2=.23 fixed. It is not JKTEBOP replication or the ELISa Roche/BB/linear-LD seed.

fit_centered_32_proposal_gaussian_batch.scope: Sequential physically varying, fit-centred local proposals; not posterior samples or vectorized MCMC.

ellc_analysis.curation_note: Corrected one diagnostic key: its fixed comparison parameters are INITIAL, not fitted baseline. Numerical arrays/timings unchanged; raw JSON and exact evidence script retained.

ellc_refinement.interpretation: Same fitted physical parameters at every resolution. These are finite pairwise diagnostics, not a continuum bound. D<=0.1 is the retained conservative project diagnostic, not a universal astronomy standard; formal-error diagonal weighting does not model correlated residuals. No thresholds or original ELISa guards changed.

reproducibility: New standalone ELISa original/JAX CPU driver is published. Retained ellc optimizer/refinement results are accompanied by exact original script/library/data/array hashes; their separate foreground fitting drivers have not been adapted into the public fitter. Raw FITS/NPZ and operational logs are not published.
interpretation: Implementation parity, finite numerical resolution and observational/model adequacy are separate conclusions. All ellc finite refinement pairs fail the retained D<=0.1 diagnostic. Preliminary conditional-trend fits and finite parameter shifts do not establish final errors or posterior significance.
